# pbs_traffic_control_rule (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server traffic control rule. Needs `Sys.Audit on /`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_traffic_control_rule" "office" {
  name = "office"
}

# Warn when the office rule no longer limits the backups the office sends.
check "office_backups_are_limited" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_traffic_control_rule.office.rate_in != null
    error_message = "Traffic control rule office has no rate_in: backups may take the office's whole uplink."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the rule to read, such as `office`.

### Read-Only

- `burst_in` (String) How many bytes over `rate_in` PBS may receive at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null when not set.
- `burst_out` (String) How many bytes over `rate_out` PBS may send at once, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null when not set.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `network` (Set of String) Client networks the rule applies to, in CIDR notation.
- `rate_in` (String) Rate limit on the data PBS receives from the matching clients, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null when not set.
- `rate_out` (String) Rate limit on the data PBS sends to the matching clients, in bytes per second, as PBS writes it, such as `10 MiB`; null when not set.
- `timeframe` (Set of String) Times the rule applies at; null for always.
- `users` (Set of String) Users the rule applies to; null for every client.
